app.title: Dashboard
app.alt: Battle Beacon dashboard showing your games, games looking for players and nearby events
app.capture: Dashboard tab, signed in, scrolled to the top. Show the My Games swipe list with at least one game, the quick actions, and the start of Games Looking for Players. Synthwave or Classic theme.

app.title: Find a game
app.alt: Battle Beacon Find Game screen listing open games at nearby venues
app.capture: All Games (Find Game) with a postcode search run. Show 3 or more game cards with venue logos, game type headers, dates and player counts.

app.title: Host a game
app.alt: Battle Beacon Create Game Request screen with a venue, table type and time slot chosen
app.capture: Create Game Request with a game system, venue and table type chosen and an available slot selected (the ticked slot visible). Fill in a game title.

app.title: Booking confirmed
app.alt: Battle Beacon payment screen confirming a table booking
app.capture: The Booking Confirmed screen straight after a paid table booking (Payment page, success state).

app.title: My Games
app.alt: Battle Beacon My Games list of hosted and joined games
app.capture: My Games with 2 to 4 active games, a mix of hosted and joined. Optional: one card mid-swipe to show Cancel / Drop out / Play.

app.title: Submit a result
app.alt: Battle Beacon Play Game screen for submitting a game result
app.capture: Play Game > Submit Result for a finished game, with the winner picked and the game type's own fields filled in.

app.title: Player profile
app.alt: Battle Beacon player profile with lifetime record, level, points and awards
app.capture: Your Profile tab showing level, points, reputation, the lifetime record (wins, losses, draws) and awards. Use an account with a real-looking record.

app.title: Messages
app.alt: Battle Beacon direct message conversation planning a game
app.capture: A Message Conversation between two friends arranging a game (a few messages each way). No real personal details.

app.title: Private game invite
app.alt: Battle Beacon Private Game Invite screen choosing a venue, date and slot
app.capture: Private Game Invite with game type, venue, date and slot chosen and a short note filled in (for example "Bring your Orks").

app.title: Venue profile
app.alt: Battle Beacon venue profile with the local store option and booking details
app.capture: A Venue Profile for a subscribed venue, showing the LOCAL STORE tick (after Set as Local), booking system and prices.
usedOn: For Venues: Works with Battle Beacon

app.title: Nearby events
app.alt: Battle Beacon Nearby Events list of tournaments and game nights
app.capture: Dashboard scrolled to Nearby Events (or the event detail page) with 2 or more upcoming events from NorthMark venues.
usedOn: For Venues: Works with Battle Beacon (second phone)

app.title: Themes
app.alt: Battle Beacon theme picker with Classic, Synthwave, Dark, Light and Ocean themes
app.capture: The theme picker open, ideally with the Synthwave theme applied behind it.
